stem_book: Paragraph: Consider f, g and h be three real valued functions defined on R. Let f(x) = sin3x + cos x, g(x) = cos3x + sin x and h(x) = f²(x) + g²(x). Question: Number of point(s) where the graphs of the two functions y = f(x) and y = g(x) intersect in [0, π], is : (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 5
work: sin3x − sin x = cos3x − cos x ⇒ 2sin x(cos2x + sin2x) = 0 ⇒ x = 0, π or tan2x = −1 ⇒ x = 3π/8, 7π/8 ⇒ 4
